metadata.title: High-Contrast Grunge Portrait with Heraldic Crest

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, desaturated portrait of a male figure looking down, paired with a complex black heraldic crest containing gothic lettering against a stark white background.
excludeWhen: minimalist modern sans-serif layouts are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, monochromatic composition featuring a close-up, high-contrast portrait of a man with shaggy hair on the left, balanced by a detailed black silhouette of a winged crest on the right. A small, sharp red triangle in the upper left corner provides the only color accent.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject looking down and away from the graphic element
Heavy black shadows in the portrait mirroring the solid black of the crest
Asymmetrical balance between the organic human form and the geometric/ornate graphic
Stark white negative space separating the two primary elements
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography with blown-out highlights
Ornate, symmetrical black crest with wing motifs
Single saturated red geometric accent in a corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The male subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped from the chest up, leaning into the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, ornate crest on the lower right acts as the primary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red corner, follows the subject's gaze downward, and then moves across to the intricate details of the crest.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the upper right and center creates a clean break between the photo and the graphic.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero mid-tones in the background and graphic; high saturation only in the small red accent.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to Black, White, and one accent color

letterConstructionRules: Vertical stress with sharp, angular terminals
Heavy stroke weight with minimal internal counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Stacked layout within the shield area of the crest
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace or small sans-serif for secondary metadata (e.g., the '06' at the bottom).

avoid: Modernist sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the traditional gothic weight and structure
Provides the necessary decorative flourishes and density

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with shaggy hair looking down, positioned on the left. Include a solid red triangle in the top left corner. The right side should be mostly white space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, ornate black heraldic crest with wings on the right side. Inside the crest, add three lines of white gothic text.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait high-contrast with deep blacks?
Is the text white and legible against the black crest?
Is the red accent limited to the top left corner?

adjustableVariables: Specific accent color in the corner

mustAchieve: Sharp graphic edges on the crest
avoid: Centered text outside of the crest

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red corner is a clean geometric shape.
Check that the blackletter text is not blurred into the crest.
Verify the subject's hair has distinct high-contrast strands.
Confirm the background is pure white, not off-white or textured.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast portrait [Subject] + Ornate [Color] Crest + [Font Style] Typography + [Color] Corner Accent
